svg.text: The Exodus to the Divided Kingdom
1491 BC – 975 BC · after Sebastian C. Adams, Synchronological Chart (1871) · open data: Theographic (CC BY-SA 4.0), STEPBible, Wikidata
Upper streams follow Ussher's chronology as Adams did (Jones/Theographic). Lower streams follow modern reign dates. Red connectors join the same event in both.
